title: Late Return and Unreturned Vehicle Schedule — Courtesy Transportation Agreements
content:
Schedule of late-return figures for Courtesy Transportation Agreements. All day counts are calendar days measured from the agreement's due date; amounts are in US dollars.

| Program | Grace after the due date (days) | Late return charge per day beyond the grace | Most late days charged per agreement | Days after the due date at which an unreturned loaner is reported to police |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 0 | 50.00 | 3 | 3 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 1 | 45.00 | 5 | 5 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 1 | 55.00 | 5 | 5 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 1 | 69.00 | 5 | 5 |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | 1 | 55.00 | 5 | 5 |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 0 | 79.00 | 10 | 10 |

Notes to the schedule:

1. **Grace** is the number of calendar days after the due date before late return is charged.
2. **Late return charge per day** is charged for each calendar day the loaner is returned late beyond the grace.
3. **Most late days charged** is the most late days charged on one agreement, however late the return.
4. **Report to police** is the number of calendar days after the due date at which a loaner that is still unreturned is reported to police as unreturned.

## Largest late return charge per agreement

Multiplying each program's per-day charge by its most late days charged gives the largest late return charge one agreement can carry:

| Program | Largest late return charge |
|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 150.00 (3 days at 50.00) |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 225.00 (5 days at 45.00) |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 275.00 (5 days at 55.00) |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 345.00 (5 days at 69.00) |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | 275.00 (5 days at 55.00) |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 790.00 (10 days at 79.00) |

## Reading the grace column

The Same-Day Courtesy Loaner and the Fleet Replacement Unit carry no grace day, so the first calendar day after the due date is already a charged late day. The four other programs carry one grace day, so the first charged late day is the second calendar day after the due date.
